description: Create or update monthly balance history entries for a single account. Every month must be a past calendar month — the current month is calculated on demand and cannot be written. The request is all-or-nothing: if any entry fails validation, none are applied. The response contains only the entries submitted, not the account's full history.

account_id.description: Id of the account to write balance history for. For deleted accounts, pass the deleted_account_id.

account_type.description: Type of account the balance history belongs to. Use manual for manually-managed accounts, plaid for synced bank accounts, crypto_manual for manually-managed crypto, and deleted for accounts that no longer exist but still have history. Synced crypto uses the dedicated crypto_synced tools instead.

balances.description: One or more monthly balance entries to create or update. If any entry fails validation the entire request is rejected and nothing is updated.

balance.description: Balance for the month, as a number or a numeric string with up to 4 decimal places (a string keeps exact precision). In the account currency for manual and Plaid accounts, or the user's primary currency for crypto and deleted accounts.

crypto_balance.description: Optional quantity of the coin itself, as a numeric string with up to 18 decimal places. Only valid for crypto_manual, crypto_synced, and deleted accounts; must not be sent for manual or plaid accounts. May be null.

currency.description: Optional three-letter currency code (case-insensitive, e.g. usd). Defaults to the account currency for manual and Plaid accounts, or the user's primary currency for crypto and deleted accounts.

id.description: Optional historical balance entry id. Accepted for input shaped like a balance history response and ignored by the server.

month.description: Month the balance applies to, as YYYY-MM. Must be a past calendar month — the current month cannot be written.

symbol.description: Optional ticker symbol (e.g. btc). Allowed for crypto_manual and deleted accounts; if set, it must match the account's symbol. Must not be sent for manual or plaid accounts. On the synced crypto tool it must match the symbol argument. May be null.

to_base.description: Optional converted balance. Accepted for input shaped like a balance history response and ignored by the server, which recalculates it from balance.

name: upsert_account_balance_history
